# MPR-UI assets

The workspace uses the JavaScript and CSS from MPR-UI release `v4.3.2`.
Source: <https://github.com/MarcoPoloResearchLab/mpr-ui/tree/v4.3.2>.
The adjacent license contains the repository MIT license.
These files are unmodified distribution assets. Application code is outside this directory.
The Pages artifact includes these assets. Browser acceptance uses the same files.
